description: Use this when the user is looking for an existing Discord community to join (by game, topic or language), e.g. a French Minecraft server or a study group. Do not use it to create or set up a server (use preview_discord_server or search_discord_templates). It searches AiGuild's public server directory and returns active servers with their member count, rating and a link to each server's page on aiguild.me, where the user can join. Nothing is created or changed, and no invite is sent.

language.description: Main language of the community. Omit for all languages.

query.description: Game, topic or name in a few words, e.g. minecraft, anime, valorant. Leave empty for the largest servers.

name: find_discord_servers
title: Find Discord servers to join
